house.description: 2026 Special Olympics USA Games funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Workforce, Labor, and Economic Development Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; 2026 SPECIAL OLYMPICS USA GAMES. +]

[+(a) $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games. +]

[+(b) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games to support activities as part of the games aimed at increasing employment of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities. +]

[+(c) These appropriations are onetime. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to economic development; appropriating money for the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; 2026 SPECIAL OLYMPICS USA GAMES.

(a) $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games.

(b) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games to support activities as part of the games aimed at increasing employment of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.

(c) These appropriations are onetime.
additions: (a) $1,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the director of Explore Minnesota for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games.

(b) $500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the workforce development fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the 2026 Special Olympics USA Games to support activities as part of the games aimed at increasing employment of individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities.
